'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Arab–Israeli conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
***[[Syria]] says that [[Israel]] has launched [[airstrike]]s on the [[international airport]]s of [[Damascus International Airport|Damascus]] and [[Aleppo International Airport|Aleppo]], taking both out of service. [[Anti-aircraft warfare|Air defences]] are activated in response to the attacks, and no casualties are reported. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syria-state-tv-says-israeli-attack-targets-aleppo-damascus-airports-2023-10-12/ (Reuters)]
**[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
***[[Israel–Hamas war]]
****[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
*****Three of five [[pumping station|water plants]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] are inoperable due to the Israeli bombings and a lack of fuel, according to the [[International Committee of the Red Cross]]. [https://www.indiatodayne.in/international/video/israels-defence-forces-with-tanks-positioned-at-the-gaza-border-3-water-plants-out-of-service-693438-2023-10-12 (India Today)]
*****[[Secretary-General of the United Nations|United Nations Secretary-General]] [[António Guterres]] says that life-saving supplies, including food, fuel and water, must be allowed into Gaza. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20231012_11/ (NHK)]
*****Israeli [[Ministry of Energy (Israel)|Energy Minister]] [[Israel Katz]] says that the [[blockade]] of Gaza will not end until all Israeli [[hostage]]s are released by [[Hamas]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-middle-east-67073970 (BBC News)]
*****Former [[Human Rights Watch]] executive director [[Kenneth Roth]] says that the ongoing attacks on Palestinian [[civilians]], carried out by Israel, could constitute a [[war crime]]. [https://dailypost.ng/2023/10/12/every-hamas-member-is-a-dead-man-israel-vows-to-wipe-palestinian-group/ (Daily Post)]
*****The [[Norwegian Refugee Council]] calls for [[humanitarian corridors]] to be established in order to allow the safe passage of personnel and relief supplies into Gaza. [https://www.nrc.no/news/2023/october/israel-gaza-nrc-calls-for-humanitarian-corridors-to-save-lives/ (NRC)]
****The [[United Nations]] says that nearly 339,000 people have been [[Forced displacement|displaced]] in Gaza by ongoing Israeli bombing raids. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/world/2023/10/12/more-than-338000-people-displaced-in-gaza-un.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]
****At least 51 people are killed and 281 others are injured in [[Israel]]i air strikes on neighborhoods in [[Gaza City]]. [https://apnews.com/article/civilian-toll-israel-palestinians-war-gaza-strikes-71177c4c45a02e0a2dab9d48615310fd (AP)] [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/bjo1ka4ba (Ynet News)]
****The death toll in Gaza increases to 1,200, with nearly 5,600 others injured. The death toll in Israel surpasses 1,400. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/10/12/more-than-333-800-people-have-been-displaced-from-gaza_6166086_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
****Israeli settlers kill a Palestinian father and son during a funeral in the [[West Bank]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/10/12/Israeli-settlers-kill-Palestinian-in-West-Bank (Al Arabiya)]
****The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Egypt)|Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Egypt]] denies rumors that the [[Rafah Border Crossing|Rafah border crossing]] is closed, asserting that the crossing remains operational and has not been closed since the beginning of the blockade. The ministry also calls upon the international community to send humanitarian aid to [[State of Palestine|Palestine]] through the [[El Arish International Airport]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/1234/510099/Egypt/Foreign-Affairs/Egypt-designates-ElArish-airport-as-Gaza-aid-hub,-.aspx (''Al-Ahram'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Three people are killed and two others are injured in [[Belgorod Oblast]], [[Russia]], after debris from a downed [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[unmanned aerial vehicle|drone]] hit several houses. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/12/two-killed-in-russia-as-debris-from-downed-ukrainian-drone-destroys-homes (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Battle of Avdiivka (2022–present)|Battle of Avdiivka]]
***[[Ukraine]] says that [[Russia]] has begun an assault on the city of [[Avdiivka]], in [[Donetsk Oblast]], supported by tanks and armored vehicles. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/10/11/world/europe/ukraine-avdiivka-russia.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[International Monetary Fund]] managing director [[Kristalina Georgieva]] confirms that [[Zambia]], the first African nation to [[Default (finance)|default]] following the [[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19 pandemic]], has agreed to a [[Debt management plan|debt agreement]] with foreign creditors concerning [[United States dollar|US$]]6.3 billion of its debt. [https://www.brecorder.com/news/40267774 (AFP via ''Business Recorder'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 Zimbabwe cholera outbreak]]
**[[Zimbabwe]] bans gatherings of more than 50 people amid a [[cholera]] outbreak in the country. [https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2023/oct/12/zimbabwe-bans-large-gatherings-as-threat-of-cholera-outbreak-grows (''The Guardian'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[Iran–Qatar relations]]
**[[United States Deputy Secretary of the Treasury|U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary]] [[Wally Adeyemo]] announces that the [[United States]] and [[Qatar]] will block [[Iran]] from receiving [[United States dollar|$]]6 billion transferred from [[South Korea]] to Qatar last month as part of a prisoner swap. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/us-qatar-agree-not-release-iran-6-billion-prisoner-swap-rcna120135 (NBC News)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2023/10/12/iran-oil-fund-us-israel/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*The [[United Nations Human Rights Council]] extends a [[United Nations special rapporteur|special rapporteur]]'s mandate to investigate [[Human rights in Russia|human rights violations in Russia]] for an additional year, despite [[Russia]]'s previous refusal to recognize the rapporteur's mandate or permit their entry into the country. [https://www.barrons.com/news/un-human-rights-council-votes-to-extend-russia-monitoring-46a4324a (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal]]
**Multinational [[investment bank]] [[Goldman Sachs]] sues the [[Malaysian government]] for alleged violations of a 2020 [[Settlement (litigation)|settlement]] related to the [[1Malaysia Development Berhad]] scandal, filing the case at the [[London Court of International Arbitration]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/10/13/world/asia-oceania/malaysia-sued-over-1mdb-settlement/1914469 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[2023 Gabonese coup d'état]]
**Former first lady [[Sylvia Bongo Ondimba]] is jailed by [[Committee for the Transition and Restoration of Institutions|the ruling military junta]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20231012-wife-of-ousted-gabon-president-ali-bongo-placed-under-house-arrest (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Death of Elijah McClain]]
**An [[Aurora Police Department]] officer who was involved in the arrest of Elijah McClain is found guilty of [[negligent homicide]] and third-degree [[assault]], while another officer is acquitted of [[manslaughter]] and assault charges. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/12/us/elijah-mcclain-police-trial-thursday/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**Rallies in support of [[State of Palestine|Palestine]] take place around the world, including in [[Argentina]], [[Canada]], [[Chile]], [[Germany]], [[Japan]], [[South Africa]], [[South Korea]], and [[Spain]]. [https://ddnews.gov.in/international/rallies-support-palestinians-take-place-many-parts-world (DD News)] [https://www.ktbs.com/news/national/argentina-palestine-supporters-rally-outside-israel-embassy---48910030/video_7a67985a-ad4b-58b7-86da-d61fb2fa7fea.html (KTBS)]
**[[French Interior Minister]] [[Gérald Darmanin]] announces that [[France]] will ban all pro-[[Palestinians|Palestinian]] protests in the country. [https://www.politico.eu/article/france-gerald-darmanin-aims-to-ban-all-pro-palestine-protests/ (Politico EU)]
*[[United States]] [[United States Senate|Senator]] [[Bob Menendez]] is charged with acting as a [[foreign agent]] for [[Egypt]] while serving as a member of the [[United States Senate]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/Politics/democratic-sen-bob-menendez-facing-additional-charges-sweeping/story?id=103928466 (ABC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Malagasy presidential election]]
**[[Madagascar]]'s [[constitutional court]] postpones the upcoming election from November 9 to November 16, amid a [[political crisis]] involving protests against the [[Ntsay government]] following [[President of Madagascar|President]] [[Andry Rajoelina]]'s resignation. [https://www.barrons.com/news/madagascar-s-top-court-orders-one-week-postponement-of-presidential-vote-b210bda6 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[October 2023 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election]]
**[[Steve Scalise]] withdraws his candidacy for [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] a day after being nominated, citing a lack of sufficient support from the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] in the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2023/10/12/steve-scalise-house-speaker-race/ (''The Washington Post'')]
